notes.title: 1.1.8 Version Update
notes.content:
[b]1.1.8 Version Update[/b]

Bug fix:
[1] Solved-In the bathroom scene, the character may be blocked by the second door.
[2] Solved-In the case of not matching the arrow keys, the character dodge action is almost invalid error.
[3] Solved-The error that the camera would jitter constantly when approaching the prison bed too close.
[4] Unknown whether it works-feedback from 2 players stated that when they saw the first CG of the BOSS,
The error that the character will take off in place. I can’t find the possibility of the error in the current link,
Therefore, the magnetic lens effect here is temporarily turned off, and I don't know if it will be effective.

New function addition/modification
[1] [Follow player suggestions] Added manual FOV lens distance adjustment function
[2] [Follow player suggestions] Modified the aiming algorithm to reduce the smooth texture of the mouse.
[3] [Follow the player's suggestion] The final male chainsaw CG can be skipped manually.
[4] [Follow player suggestions] The language selection bar can be confirmed by double-clicking.
[5] [Follow player suggestions] Improved the operating speed of the flashlight

Other in progress
[1] XBOX handle operation is supported, but the handle UI prompt has not been adapted


[b]Other instructions:[/b]
Recently, we are developing version 2.0. At the same time we are doing publicity.
I'm so busy, so I don't have any energy to take care of the Steam community and emails these days.
I may have missed some important news, so sorry.

Airtight City 1.0 has not yet reached what I want, so it will continue to be updated.
There is still a missing link behind the main plot.
I will gradually complete this part of the content.


[b]Also tell everyone a good news,[/b]
My game promotion seems to have a little effect,
Although the current income is not much, I can barely maintain my subsequent development work.
This makes me very encouraged.
I firmly believe that just keep working hard.
The dream will eventually come true.
Look forward to Airtight City 2.0.

The above text comes from Google Translate, which may be strange to read.

notes.title: New Version 1.1.4B
notes.content:
After consulting everyone's suggestions, the game has the following changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35217530/ac5faeb06b5759bb15b806be21d27606ea840f57.png[/img]

[1] The flashlight has been changed to manual control on and off.
     <1> Added related tutorials on flashlight operation
     <2> UI tips related to flashlight operation

[2] Changes in the overall atmosphere of the game
      <1> Basic brightness increased
      <2> Increased color saturation
      <3> Farther and clearer lighting effect.

[3] The FOV angle of view has been extended to prevent characters from obstructing too much content.

[4] Prison scene changes
      <1> Added prompt text to prevent players from not understanding why the protagonist should squat down.
      <2> Enriched the content of the scene and enhanced the sense of horror.


[5] A new save point has been added
       Avoid the problem that players still have to face the group of monsters again after being killed by the BOSS. Reduce frustration.

[6] Made a simple ending.

[7] Bug fix
      <1> Solved the voice mono error.
      <2> Solved the problem that players and monsters may get stuck by the terrain near the elevator.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35217530/8fde29acf1e4d1120777114ffe19457715f1ffd8.jpg[/img]
I am currently taking care of two games alone, and the progress is a bit slow.
Airtight City 2.0 will be the main focus of work. After all, the income that 1.0 currently brings is really hard to maintain my job.
Realistic difficulties are far more difficult to solve than technical difficulties.
I'm sorry for the price changes of the game, I hope you can understand.

[Google Translate / Maybe feel strange to read]

notes.title: New Version 1.1.1
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixed [/b]
[0] The shortcut key for replacing the filter element prompts incorrectly.

[1] Reduce the flicker intensity under mental interference state to avoid eye discomfort.



[b]Game optimization[/b]
[0] When the item cannot be picked up, there will be a more eye-catching UI prompt.

[1] Smarter teaching tips, when the player performs the correct operation, the teaching will be automatically closed, and there is no need to cancel it manually.

[2] Optimized flashlight system. Improve basic brightness.
     <0> Aiming state, the flashlight is in the spotlight mode, the irradiation distance is long, the angle is 
     small, and the brightness is high.

     <1> Non-targeting state, the flashlight is in astigmatism mode, the irradiation distance is medium, the 
     angle is large, and the brightness is medium.



[b]Data adjustment[/b]
[0] Pistol data changes-increased basic ammunition load, reduced recoil.
[1] Rifle data changes-Increase basic ammunition load, reduce recoil, and increase shooting speed by 10%.
[2] The number of backpack grids has been increased.



[b]Special changes[/b]
In response to the black screen problem encountered by very few players, some log interfaces have been added to help me locate the cause of the problem.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35217530/015fa5f5fba6ac1ef61713028b07dd64157a4bf9.jpg[/img]

notes.title: BLACK SCREEN PROBLEM - CHECK VERION-2
notes.content:
New Version - PLEASE HELP ME FIX BLACK SCREEN PROBLEM
Some players will have a permanent black screen after playing on the Logo interface.
I currently guess that the problem may come from 3 directions:
[1] A staged error in the scene loading process.
[2] Reading or application error of game resolution.
[3] Unknown issue with Unity engine version

My current solution requires the cooperation of players who have the black screen problem to solve.
Need everyone's help.

[1] Under this game version.
After the game runs, it will perform 13 steps and finally enter the game successfully.
I have added Log output to all key unknowns. It is used to judge possible loading problems.

[2] Under this game version
The game will read and output your computer resolution and write it to the log file.

Players who have the black screen problem, please follow the black screen.
Go to this address, find the following 2 files, and send them to me.
This will help me determine the source of the problem.

file path : C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\LocalLow\LittleBeanGames\The Airtight City2020
(PS: Administrator is your pc user name)
file 1 : output_log.txt
file 2 : GameSettingConfig.txt

I'm really sorry for causing trouble to everyone.

需要大家的帮助。
